create_masked_vqa2_builder: create a MaskedVQA2Builder instance that inherits from VQA2Builder and uses MaskedVQA2Dataset
review_masked_vqa2_config_path: review the MaskedVQA2Builder config_path method that returns configs/datasets/vqa2/masked.yaml
test_masked_vqa2_registration: test that MaskedVQA2Builder is registered with the MMF registry under the key masked_vqa2
summarize_masked_vqa2_init: summarize the MaskedVQA2Builder init method that sets dataset_name and dataset_class attributes
